mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level directly increases discount rates for equity valuation and reduces corporate borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a 0.5% monthly decline in industrial production signals manufacturing slowdown, triggering negative equity market sentiment and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 1 month during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP growth level (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds its 1-year moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point rise in CPI over three months signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and increasing real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate dual shock of weak labor market and restrictive monetary policy, depressing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, a 0.5% monthly decline in housing starts signals weakening housing sector activity, a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines > 0.5% in 1 month during early-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
